stocks.use: Selected Ponoko #4 brushed 304 stainless; live quote option 1.52 mm, stock range1.44-1.64. Explicit vendor variant versus1.524 baseline.

design.preferred_material: Metal alternative: Ponoko #4 brushed 304 stainless, 1.52 mm nominal, brushed on one face. Actual quote offers Linear Deburring for MAIN only; DIV is As cut and needs safe-edge finishing arranged separately. Clear-first is the current recommendation. No exact Kohler BN match.
design.locator_decision: Select plain upright capsule and a removable four-direction concentric gauge. R006 round-hole/slot tabs were evaluated at 6.4, 7 and 8 mm. Current captured shafts conflict near the seated A tab; current enlarged rod ends also obstruct insertion. Retraction/removal can remove the tip-path conflict but does not establish shaft/formed-plate plane registration. Widening locators adds more stack play than the 1 mm nominal inward gasket reserve. Plain access plus removable centering avoids making those uncertain rod axes an extra constraint.
design.outer_appearance: Each backing circle concentric with its actual factory cover, constant visible border. Main and diverter border widths need not match each other.

requested_shop_targets.thickness: Use stated stock, report actual thickness range and finishing loss; no silent gauge substitution
requested_shop_targets.edge: Deburr both faces and all aperture edges; remove cutting microtabs, sharp corners, burr and heat tint; preserve contour
requested_shop_targets.finish: Uniform directional satin grain, same direction on both parts, protect visible face. Confirm final cost and lead time. No exact BN match promised.

design.support: Thin metal is a supported facing/seal landing, not a structural patch spanning unsupported stone damage. Expert must establish firm continuous support at sealing and clamping zones. No tile alteration authorized.

foam.status: Edge-flush foam user-confirmed; actual rear outline, compression and corner radius require physical contact verification

design.depth: Added height = actual custom thickness + effective support/bedding height. Do not infer permitted engagement from free foam height or a generic 5 mm tolerance.
design.manufacture_scope: Two selected standalone plate shapes for a sacrificial fit trial. Private Ponoko draft quotes authorized; no purchase or permanent-use approval.

positioning_aid.type: removable radial border gauges and matched visual overlay
positioning_aid.location: Gauge touches visible cover rim and backing outer edge from front; never under factory gasket

positioning_aid.retention: Removable low-tack tape during fitting. Properly supported factory assembly supplies normal clamping in service; no assumed sealant structural strength. If it can shift or rock after correct assembly, stop and correct support/retention.
